senses.gloss: तृष्णा- + तन्तु तृष्णा- + तन्तु, m. the thread of desire, MBh. 12, 7877.

1. तृष् तृष्, i. 4, Par. To thirst.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. तृषित.
 1. Thirsty, MBh. 3, 101.
 2. Desirous, Rām. 2, 104, 1.
 3. Greedy, Ṛt. 1, 18.
 --Cf. O.H.G. durst; A.S. thurst; Goth. thaursjan, thairsan, thaursus; A.S. thyrr; τέρσομαι, ταρσός, τρασιά; Lat. torrere.

तृषा तृष् + आ, f.
 1. Thirst, Pañc. 81, 22.
 2. Desire, Hit. i. d. 133.
 --Comp.
तृष्णज् तृष्णज्, i. e. तृष् + न-ज, adj. Thirsty, Chr. 289, 11 = Rigv. i. 85, 11.

तृष्णा तृष्णा, i. e. तृष् + न, f.
 1. Thirst, Man. 8, 67.
 2. Desire, Bhartṛ. 2, 70.
 --Comp.
तृष्णालु तृष्णा + लु, adj. Very thirsty, Suśr. 2, 383, 19.
तृषा- + रोग तृषा- + रोग, m. a morbose thirst, MBh. 12, 11268.
